title: feat(console): the create-workspace dialog shows the unpaid-organization limit refusal and its next step
body:
Fixes #34221

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/i18n` gains `organization.errors.unpaidOrganizationLimitReached` and `organization.viewPlans` in every locale
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在云端控制台建第三个免费组织被拒时，「新建组织」对话框显示云端给的本地化说明（含下一步），云端若提供升级入口还会多一个「查看套餐并升级」链接。
- 为什么做：云端已对每个账号限 2 个免费组织并返回新的拒绝码，控制台原来不认识它（来自云端免费组织上限那张卡的控制台一半）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是仍显示云端原句或控制台的通用兜底句，不会建出组织，也不影响其他拒绝；直接撤回本 PR 即可。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `orgErrorMessage.ts` maps `UNPAID_ORGANIZATION_LIMIT_REACHED`. The row is marked `preferUserMessage`, so the control plane's own `userMessage` is shown as sent: it is written in the request's language and names the next step (ruling C on #32440, the same rule `SettingsPage` applies to the delete refusal). A refusal without a `userMessage` shows the new console key `organization.errors.unpaidOrganizationLimitReached`, in all eleven locales. That sentence names no number and no plan. Every other row ignores `userMessage` exactly as before.
- New `readOrgCreateNextStep(err)` reads `details.next_step` (`upgrade_to_team` | `contact_support`), for this code only. Values this console does not know read as no step.
- `CreateWorkspaceDialog` draws a link under the error when the step is `upgrade_to_team` AND the host serves `getUpgradeUrl()` (new key `organization.viewPlans`). The console never builds the address (ADR-0060; the runtime-config contract). `contact_support` draws no link: the sentence already names the contact address.
- Producer read on cloud `origin/main` (`packages/service-cloud/src/unpaid-organization-cap.ts`): 403, flat `{ code, message, userMessage, details: { unpaid_organization_limit, unpaid_organizations, next_step } }`. `createOrganization` throws through `toAuthError`, which carries `code`, `userMessage` and `details` from the flat body, or from the ADR-0112 envelope's `error` when the flat body has none. `createWithGeneratedSlug` rethrows any refusal that is not a slug collision unchanged, so the code reaches the dialog.

## Tests

- `orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`, new describe: producer `userMessage` preferred; pack fallback when it is absent or blank; every pack defines the key, no digits, not the English; `readOrgCreateNextStep` for both steps, an unknown step, no details, another code, and a bare Error; CONTROL: `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS` still maps to its pack sentence and ignores a `userMessage`. The mapping-table code list gains the new code.
- `CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: `upgrade_to_team` with a served entry shows the sentence and a link to it, with no retry and no provision; with no served entry there is no link; `contact_support` shows no link; a refusal without `userMessage` shows the zh pack sentence; CONTROL: better-auth's limit refusal shows no link.

## Acceptance notes

- Item 2 of the card (warn before the click) is not done: neither `/auth/config` nor discovery states the unpaid limit. The only source is the refusal itself.
- The control plane's own runtime config (cloud `createStudioRuntimeConfigPlugin`) serves no `upgradeUrl` today. Tenant runtimes get one from `cloud-runtime-config-plugin`. So on the control plane console, where this cap fires, the link stays hidden until cloud serves the key there. The sentence still gives the step. Carrier: cloud.
- The fallback sentence is generic about the step ("upgrade one of them to a paid plan or contact support"). It shows only when the producer sent no sentence, which the current cloud producer never does.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts`: the `preferUserMessage` branch in `resolveOrgErrorMessage`, and `readOrgCreateNextStep`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`: the `setUpgradeUrl` line in the catch, and the link.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: the two new keys.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`. Expected: every test passes, including the six in the `UNPAID_ORGANIZATION_LIMIT_REACHED` describe.

Commit `4dd68691` (all local readings below were taken on this head):

`CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`, `orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`, `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, `en-zh-key-parity.test.ts`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 113 passed (113), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

Ablation: with the `preferUserMessage` branch disabled and the `setUpgradeUrl` read stubbed out on disk, 3 tests went red (the userMessage pin, plus the two dialog upgrade cases). Restored from HEAD, and the tree was clean afterwards.
</details>
